reviews.title: Great flight and services!
reviews.text: I never heard about this company before, so I decided to look for reviews on TripAdvisor to get to know more about its services. I was skeptical after reading the reviews, but in the end it turns out that the flight was pleasant. There was no delay at all. The cabin crew very attentive and the pilot information precise and clear. I would definitely fly with Transavia again, thank you!
reviews.author: Lannah

reviews.title: Worst customer EVER!!!
reviews.text: Do not use. They canceled our flight AFTER taking our luggage. Tools hours to get them back. They wouldn’t even tell us how long we had to wait to get them back. They wouldn’t help us get on another flight. Had to try and get a room in sold out Paris which was very very expensive. The absolute worst company.
reviews.author: Ryanne E

reviews.title: Nope
reviews.text: Both flights (inbound & outbound) delayed, poor passengers space, rude personnel, poor baggage management (half of the cabinets were empty yet they made us drop them off)
reviews.author: bob p

reviews.title: Delay aftwr Delay
reviews.text: If you are ever tight on time, do NOT use this airline service. Delay of over one hour of having us stand on the boarding ramp - with no explanation of why there was a delay at this stage when they requested people to board. And on arrival for a different flight from the same company, we had to wait one hour for any baggage to be placed on the belt...once again with no explanation. Why a flight needs 60 minutes to offload baggage is beyond me.
reviews.author: shomgauznabi

reviews.title: Irresponsible and bureaucratic airline
reviews.text: Mistakes are made by Transavia, but it is the customer to suffer. BTW, they don’t care about the claim you made. Have tried it twice. Never work. I booked a round flight half year ago, and Transavia cancelled the onward flight one month ago when price has been doubled. No additional compensation is granted. What’s even worse was that I especially asked them to secure the return flight (which was not cancelled) and they said yes, but they forgot to put note in the system, so the flight was also cancelled. Eventually I got to rebook my tickets which were supposed to keep, and paid additionally….
reviews.author: 勝智 吳

reviews.title: Servicio horrible. Anulación en el último momento
reviews.text: Attention! Ils annulent votre voyage au dernier moment!! Cuidad! Cancelan su vuelo en el último momento! Be careful! They’ ll cancel your flight at the last moment!
reviews.author: carolina g

reviews.title: Never book through this airline! They treat you as dirt!
reviews.text: This airline and its staff treat their customers so badly. We were one of the first ones to board, and although disclosing that we were carrying medicine that needs to be in the cabin with us. At the counter the staff members told us that this wouldn’t be a problem as long as we were part of the 65 cabin bags, which we were. But instead the aircraft staff denied us boarding our bag in the airplane. One of the staff member both tried to force the bag out of my wife’s hands and was hysterically yelling at us and refused to listen to what we were told at the counter. We desperately tried to show the official healthcare travel letter we had with us, which clearly stated that the medicine needs to be in the cabin! My wife was completely destressed by this situation and had to leave the bag behind. Once we entered the aircraft and it was fully boarded, we could clearly see that there was plenty of space in the aircraft. This is the last time we ever book tickets through Transavia! The staff is rude, has zero sense for customer service or decency! Never book this airline again
reviews.author: Maria M

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Airline damaged my luggage and refuses to pay. They make you pay for checked baggage, and they break the bag. Not worth it. I just bought this suitcase, how do you even make a crack like that? The suitcase doesn't even want to roll because of what your airline did. Disappointed.
reviews.author: CINY

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: They didnt let us on the plane… no help by rebooking or else. Nobody at the desk speaking english. Our loss 800 € they regund us 100€. DO NOT BOOK WITH THIS COMPANY!!!
reviews.author: Eszter

reviews.title: NEVER AGAIN!!!
reviews.text: Transavia cancelled our flight and tried to charge us full price for new flight!!!! After 4/5 hours of our Hotel Manager speaking to them in French they finally gave in and admitted it was their responsibility to rebook us for free due to strike action at the Airport. How dare they, the stress they caused my family and I was horrendous and traumatic.....
reviews.author: avagrace107

reviews.title: !!! SCAM ALERT!!!!!! ALERTE ESCROQUERIE !!!
reviews.text: !!! SCAM ALERT!!!!!! ALERTE ESCROQUERIE !!! (Second paragraphe en VF) I booked a ticket to leave for Ibiza today, June 6, 2023 at 5:35pm. In order to benefit from an advantageous rate, I made my reservation on March 14, 2023. When I logged into my personal e-mail address to check in last night, I found that Transavia had cancelled my flight and rebooked me on a flight 24 hours earlier (June 5). When I called customer service to find a solution, they told me that technically I had missed my flight and that they could simply refund €124 and I could book a new ticket. To leave tomorrow June 7 the ticket is 820€ for 2. It would seem that you have to be at Transavia's disposal to take the flights they assign you without your consent, or keep an eye on your email 24/7 so as not to be fooled. !!!WHAT A SHAME !! _______________________________________________________ !!! ALERTE ESCROQUERIE !!! J'ai réservé un billet pour partir à Ibiza aujourd'hui, le 6 juin 2023 à 17H35. Afin de pouvoir bénéficier d'un tarif avantageux, j'ai effectué ma reservation le 14 mars 2023. Quand je me suis connecté à mon adresse mail perso pour faire mon check-in hier soir, je me suis aperçu que Transavia avait annulé mon vol et m'avait replacer sur un vol 24h plus tot (le 5 juin). Quand j'ai appelé le service client pour trouver une solution, ils m'ont indiqué que techniquement j'avais raté mon vol et qu'il pouvait simplement rembourser 124€ et que je pouvais réserver un nouveau billet. Pour partir demain
reviews.author: Lancelot R

reviews.title: Amsterdam- Bodrum vv, Average
reviews.text: Check-in and boarding went quickly and smoothly. We were supposed to leave at 16.00 but around 16:10 the captain announced that we were delayed because luggage still had to be loaded. At 16.35 the engines were started and push back was at 16.39. We airborned at 16.55. The crew were friendly and helpful. On flights operated by this budget point-to-point carrier, meals and drinks are not included. You had to buy everything. The crew came by twice with cold, hot and alcoholic drinks, noodles, sandwiches, chips, etc. You could order meals when booking the flight. Payment was only possible with cards. It was announced that you could indicate if you wanted to buy tax-free stuff. There was no wifi. There was an inflight magazine but no inflight entertainment. The seats in this fully booked Boeing 737-800 are tight together. For me, the seat width and legroom is reasonable. I am not that big. But I think that a tall person will have problems. The lavatories are kept clean. Despite our departure with a delay of 39 minutes, we still landed on time. We were connected to the aerobridge and disembarking went smootly. After passport control the suitcases were already on the carousel. When checking in on the return flight, my girlfriend and i were separated even though we had a joint ticket. The lady who checked us in said she couldn't help it because the places had already been allocated by Transavia in advance. Fortunately, passengers were willing to change places so that we could sit tog
reviews.author: John v

reviews.title: NO COMPENSATION
reviews.text: booked a weekend away for our staff. Transavia cancelled on evening before departure . It took 6 months to get our fare money back but still no compensation or even remuneration for the lost hotel bookings. Lost all faith in Transavia
reviews.author: Damian

reviews.title: Lost our carry-on bagage
reviews.text: We booked a flight from Faro to Stockholm with a stop-over in Amsterdam and paid extra for the carry-on trolley. When boarding we were told we could not bring the carry-on in the plane. I explained we have a stop-over and we didn't want to check-in our bags. The ground crew got quite aggressive and unprofessional and we were basically forced in handing over our carry-on trolleys. The labels were being handwritten which was adding to my concern. The ground crew told us 'Don't worry, your baggage will go to Stockholm". As expected, on arrival in Stockholm our baggage was lost and nobody could tell us where it is. Avoid Transavia at all cost if your baggage is precious to you.
reviews.author: Likemike

reviews.title: Avoid at all cost - Do Not Fly!
reviews.text: DO NOT FLY TRANSAVIA! We had a family emergency happen, which we unfortunately could no longer go as planned, which was we knew a refund was not possible, and tried numerous times on their web/app which advised us to call their useless customer help line and from there, asked customer service to help us rebook to another flight. To which, the imbecile of a rep we spoke to told us its not possible to have them do it over the phone, we told him numerous times it is not possible to switch the flight on their website nor their app and that we were asked to call. He would not listen to anything suggestion we had, I am pretty sure he was hyperventilating at one point even though we not once raised our voice and simply asked for him to calm down and just listen to find a solution together, he was immensely rude, short, and kept repeating he can't help rebook and that Transavia advised him he can't stay on calls for more than 10 minutes. How in the world is that customer service nor reasonable I do not understand. It's almost a waste even taking the time to write these reviews because nothing will change, they will remain useless, and not sure what is the point of having customer services reps at all.
reviews.author: esmertalime

reviews.title: A Terrible flight
reviews.text: I booked a flight from ORY-PRG on New year 2023. I had a cold symptom. I have an option that I could go or stay. When I tried to cancel a flight on the transavia website. It showed” I will receive a refund for my ticket”. I screenshotted that web and kept it. After, they refused to give a refund. I checked google, and found a lot of issues about what cumstome never getting a refund from them. God will punish them.
reviews.author: wendy w

reviews.title: THEIR IRRESPONSIBLE & UNCLEAR  SMS MESSAGE CAUSED US TO MISS OUR FLIGHT!!!
reviews.text: We had just completed a lovely holiday in Amsterdam (Tulip Season) and were ready to fly back when I received the following SMS a few hours prior scheduled departure of our flight which was originally 1935 hours Monday 25th April 2023: "Your flight HV5587 to Nice on 24/04/2023 has been delayed. The new departure time is 21:35. Our apologies, Transavia." Based on this brief message we decided to go two hours later to the airport so as not to pass 4 hours there. When we reached at 1930 (two hours before the new departure time) we were shocked to see bag drop closed and no one present at the counter (all we had to do was drop our suitcases, having checked in online the previous night) Long story short - since there was no Transavia flight till Wednesday and I had important meetings to attend the next day I bought two tickets on the spot with KLM to Milan Linate Departure 2100, checked our bags, boarded the flight , booked hotel and train tickets to Monaco early the next morning all under great tension and expense. At least I had the means and presence of mind to do so, I shudder to think what if this was to happen to some old people or young student - Transavia would just abandon them as they did to us. I took up the matter with their non existent client service department. Their first reply made me laugh, the reviewer had not even read my complaint. After repeated attempts I finally got them to admit that the SMS "is the most effective way to communicate sudden alteration of th
reviews.author: Ashley C

reviews.title: Waardeloos bedrijf
reviews.text: Flight adjusted 2 weeks before departure and moved 2.5 days, then canceled because they have no planes. Isn't that your core business??? What lousy service and poor communication. You will never see me again and I know countless people who feel that way. Do you want to go on vacation? Then don't book with Transavia!
reviews.author: Stefan B

reviews.title: Reliable services, though quite expensive for a low-cost carrier.
reviews.text: The flights were on-time, hassle-free. There is one refuel stop-over. Seats are quite uncomfortable, available meals to be purchased on board were OK.
reviews.author: Vali & Mihai

reviews.title: Damaged my bags
reviews.text: Damaged my bags, and they will not pay anything to me, and delayed about 2 hours in two ways , unfortunately it is very bad.

reviews.title: As bad as low cost Airlines can getter.
reviews.text: Last resort airline. Late out, late back. Minimum leg room, poor onboard food, unwelcoming personnel ...
reviews.author: Ian B

reviews.title: very friendly crew!
reviews.text: Overall the flights are great. There is always a last minute one hour delay on the way back from Beirut to Amsterdam.
reviews.author: Ramzi Sarieddine

reviews.title: Terrible experience: delay and no information
reviews.text: Third and last time with Transavia. Always delayed. No information. Change of airplane to unknown company. Technical problems with airplane. Very poor service. Worst every company . They have total chaos in their logistics.
reviews.author: Monika

reviews.title: Transavia custom service
reviews.text: I had left a bad review of Transavia customer service but once I found the right way to communicate with them they were great. I hereby retract my previous 1 star review and am changing it to a 5 star. Thank you Transavia customer service!
reviews.author: John Doe

reviews.title: Xenophobic worse company and costumer services EVER
reviews.text: On the boarding, the crew would greet everybody before me (including my husband and ppl behind me) and completely ignore me a whole flight. On departure the same, greeting to my ppl in front of me, silence when I pass and greet for my husband just after me. Very crew and xenophobic crew. Not to mention that the boarding is so messy, huge lines to get in the plane and still wait 40 minutes with no further information. And once again, to collect the luggage long long wait. I'll be sure to remember in a bad way this company and never book my future flights with them.
reviews.author: Isabela A

reviews.title: S**t customer service
reviews.text: Good luck getting useful custom service. Good luck getting useful custom service. Good luck getting useful custom service.Good luck getting useful custom service.
reviews.author: John Doe

reviews.title: Cancelled flight
reviews.text: They cancelled our flight back home 2 days for departure.. The Dutch-speaking helpdesk wasn't in the air either ;) Luckily the English helpdesk was available but they could only offer us a flight back home 5 days afther our booked flight. I think that if Transavia bring you to your holliday destination, they also are responsable for bringing you home in time. They knew there were problems coming up.. so don't bring people if you cannot fly them home. The very worst answer we got from the helpdesk was when we shared that we should be home in time was... "we can give you your money back". How does that help us? Treat us as people please! We called back because we found a flight ourself from the nearest airport to Sevilla. The helpdesk did the rebooking correctly.
reviews.author: Jeroen Schapendonk

reviews.title: flight delayed and company do not take responsibility
reviews.text: flight was delayed for more than 5 hours. officially transavia claimed that it was delayed for 4 hours and 58 minutes however we were on ground for extra half an hour till take of. company claimed that the delay was due to a terrorist action occured the night before (about 9 hours before planend take off) however out of many flights at this hour only transavia flight was delayed. we planned for 3 days vacation and due to the delay, instead of arriving on the morning to paris we arrived late afternoon. that day the company had to flights. we payed more to geat early and eventually lost almost the first day. the story was ok if company would take responsibility for its actions but this company didn't and there is no one to talk to besides bots. so, when you plan your next flight, consider wisely what type of company you prefer. in our case, we payed more, got less and still it is considered a lowcost company so there wont be a next time with them.
reviews.author: goldihon

reviews.title: Window not sealed during take off
reviews.text: After cancelling the flight back to Amsterdam twice I had the hope that there will be no delay this time. 1 sec before taking off the plane stopped because a window was not sealed. We stayed in the plane for 1 hour before leaving. Transavia is a disappointment.
reviews.author: Anthi T

reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: Booked a citytrip to Copenhagen through TUI, but flights were with Transavia. Everything went smooth, from buying upgrades, to online check-in, boarding and of course, the flights. I had upgraded to guaranteed hand luggage with priority boarding and this was perfectly managed at both airports. Flight attendants were super friendly. Seats were comfortable with plenty of legroom. Would definitely fly with Transavia again.
reviews.author: Reinier
